verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada is a government registry service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. The probe notes the registry documents no transactional API, and the open.canada.ca CKAN API is a separate open-data platform that is not MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
